users.disable_confirm_body: Their sessions and access tokens stop working within a minute. You can re-enable them at any time.

users.impersonate_confirm_body: You will act as this user for 30 minutes or until you exit. The session start and end are recorded in the audit log.

mcp_server.title: MCP Server
mcp_server.description: Runtime status of the external MCP service and its OAuth authorization server.

oauth.clients_hint: Registered clients can connect to the external MCP service. The plaintext client_secret is shown exactly once, at create or rotate time.
oauth.create_description: The plaintext client_secret is shown only this once — store it now.
oauth.redirect_uris_hint: One per line; matched exactly at authorize time.
oauth.edit_description: Update the name and redirect URIs.
oauth.rotate_confirm_body: The old secret stops working immediately; tokens already issued stay valid until they expire. The new secret is shown once.
oauth.disable_confirm_body: A disabled client cannot exchange new tokens and all of its user grants are revoked; existing tokens fail within the cache window (up to ~10 minutes).
oauth.enable_confirm_body: An enabled client can start new authorization flows again.
oauth.delete_confirm_body: All of its user grants are revoked too. This cannot be undone.
oauth.revoke_grant_confirm_body: The user's existing tokens for this client fail within the cache window (up to ~10 minutes).
oauth.secret_once_warning: Store it now — this plaintext is never shown again.

banner.stop_failed: Could not exit impersonation. Your session may have expired — sign in again.
